scenario: ship-by deadline passed with no dispatch
rationale: The buyer should not be charged when no tracking was submitted before the ship-by deadline.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example has no parcel or tracking after the agreed ship-by deadline. This is a synthetic authorization-only deal.
Bob Example confirms that no tracking was submitted before the deadline. No capture occurred.

rationale: A tracking record that predates the order requires a person to check which parcel it describes.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example shows that the tracking record was created one day before this synthetic order. The parcel identity is disputed.
Bob Example supplied that earlier tracking record without a matching order reference. No later shipping record is available.

scenario: tracking delivered to a different agreed destination
rationale: Delivery to synthetic destination B instead of agreed destination A must not trigger release.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example agreed synthetic destination A but the delivery record names synthetic destination B. The two destinations do not match.
Bob Example provides the record for destination B as delivery evidence. There is no record for destination A.

scenario: inspection timer expired but tracking never shows delivery
rationale: The buyer is right to oppose release while the stored delivery check is false, even if the timer expired.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example has not received the parcel and tracking is still in transit when the inspection timer expires. There is no delivery scan.
Bob Example asks for release based on the expired timer despite the in-transit record. The synthetic delivery fact is false.

scenario: captured payment and a timely return delivered to the seller
rationale: After a human-required return reaches the seller on time, the captured payment should be refunded in full.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example returned the synthetic item to the seller before the return deadline and the delivery destination matches. A human refund decision already exists.
Bob Example acknowledges the timely return delivery to the agreed seller destination. The payment had already been captured.

scenario: buyer asks for cancellation before the shipping deadline
rationale: The seller remains within the agreed shipping window, so no missed-deadline void should run.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example asks to void the deal before the agreed ship-by deadline has passed. No tracking has been required yet.
Bob Example is still within the agreed shipping window and has not submitted tracking. The deadline-passed fact is false.

scenario: matching delivery and explicit buyer confirmation
rationale: Matching delivered tracking and the buyer confirmation support release when no dispute is open.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example confirms receipt of the matching synthetic parcel with no dispute. Delivery is recorded at the agreed destination.
Bob Example supplied consistent tracking for the order and the buyer confirmed receipt. The inspection timer is still open.

scenario: matching delivery and silent buyer after inspection
rationale: Consistent delivery plus an expired dispute-free inspection window supports release.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example received the matching synthetic parcel and did not open a dispute before inspection expired. The buyer has not explicitly confirmed.
Bob Example supplied consistent delivered tracking for the agreed destination. The inspection window has expired without a dispute.

scenario: required return never delivered before the deadline
rationale: A buyer who keeps the item past the required-return deadline should not receive the pending refund.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example kept the synthetic item and no delivered return exists after the return deadline. The payment is still only authorized.
Bob Example has not received the required return after the deadline. The pending human refund was conditional on that return.

scenario: buyer asks for the refund while the return is still in transit
rationale: The seller is right to await a delivered return while the return deadline is still open.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example requests the refund before the required return is delivered. The return is in transit and the deadline is still open.
Bob Example has not received the return and asks to wait for delivery. The earlier human decision requires a return.

scenario: delivery scan has no destination data
rationale: A person should review a delivered scan whose missing destination prevents checking the agreed address.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example disputes whether the delivery scan belongs to the agreed destination because the destination field is missing. No mismatch is proven.
Bob Example provides a delivered scan with no destination information. The inspection timer expired, but the destination fact remains unknown.

scenario: return marked delivered at a different destination
rationale: A person should resolve the conflicting return record instead of treating a wrong-destination scan as receipt by the seller.
criteria: Whether the synthetic shipping or return facts permit the next payment action

evidence.content: Alice Example shows a return delivery scan for synthetic destination B instead of agreed seller destination A. The buyer says the courier label is wrong.
Bob Example denies receiving the return at synthetic destination A. The scan records destination B before the deadline.
